import pandas as pd
import json

# Get the metrics dataframe
metrics_df = get_dataframe('metrics')

# Parse the requests column to extract individual request details
requests_data = []
for idx, row in metrics_df.iterrows():
    req = row['requests']
    if isinstance(req, str):
        req = json.loads(req.replace("'", '"'))
    requests_data.append(req)

# Create a DataFrame from the parsed requests
requests_df = pd.DataFrame(requests_data)
requests_df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(requests_df['timestamp'])

# Display basic info
print("Requests DataFrame Shape:", requests_df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", requests_df.columns.tolist())
print("\nData Types:")
print(requests_df.dtypes)
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(requests_df.head())
print("\nBasic Statistics:")
print(requests_df.describe())

result = requests_df
